definitions.supplemental: Dut. ver-smelten to melt, dissolve: Ger. ver-schmelzen to melt away.
definitions.meaning: To melt away, become liquid, liquefy

quotations.english: he commanded the weapons all to melt away

quotations.old_english: Formealt oððe hnesce geworden is eorþe

source_text: for-meltan, -myltan; p. -mealt, pl. -multon; pp. -molten; v. intrans. To melt away, become liquid, liquefy; l&i-short;quesc&e-short;re, l&e-short;qu&e-short;fi&e-short;ri :-- Hét wǽpen eall formeltan he commanded the weapons all to melt away, Andr. Kmbl. 2294; An. 1148. Formealt oððe hnesce geworden is eorþe l&i-short;qu&e-short;facta est terra, Ps. Lamb. 74, 4: Ex. 16, 21. Ealle ða scipu formultan all the ships were consumed, Ors. 5, 4; Bos. 105, 14. [Dut. ver-smelten to melt, dissolve: Ger. ver-schmelzen to melt away.]
